style: Say in a calm, confident, warm narrator voice

lines.vo01: Real recordings are messy: retakes, false starts, breaths, long pauses.
lines.vo04: Drop in a recording, pick a model — it can run locally, right on your computer — and press Voice Cut.
lines.vo05: It transcribes everything you said, reads it like an editor, and keeps the best take of every line.
lines.vo06: It cuts only in the silence between words, and turns breaths into your own room tone.
lines.vo09: VoiceCut is free and open source. Run it on your own computer, or with your own key for OpenRouter, Gemini, OpenAI or DeepSeek.
lines.vo10: Record with all your retakes. Get back one clean take.
